scenes.role: Establish Nella’s ordinary want and the fruit-market setting.
prerequisites: Opening of the market day
actions: Nella seeks a chance to serve customers
consequences: Her wish to earn Rafi’s trust is established
prose_obligations: Keep Nella eager but not magically experienced

scenes.role: Give the neighbor a concrete order and deadline.
prerequisites: Market counter is open
actions: Mrs. Vale requests apples for a clinic tart and pays
consequences: Order size and payment are tracked
prose_obligations: State why the fruit matters to the neighbor

scenes.role: Enact the borrowed object and its owner’s expectation.
prerequisites: Rafi owns the scale; order has been accepted
actions: Nella borrows the scale
consequences: Custody changes; returning a useful scale remains required
prose_obligations: Mention clean return and accurate weighing

scenes.role: Optional kindness vignette that consumes one apple from stock.
prerequisites: Order accepted; at least one apple remains
actions: Nella gives Sam a bruised apple for stew
consequences: Apple inventory falls by one; Sam receives the fruit
prose_obligations: Make the apple useful rather than wasteful

scenes.role: Optional tasting vignette that can change the neighbor’s willingness to blend fruit.
prerequisites: Order accepted; pear sample available
actions: Nella offers a pear sample; Mrs. Vale tastes it
consequences: One pear is consumed; neighbor becomes willing to mix fruit
prose_obligations: A sample changes a preference through a real taste

scenes.role: Prepare the basket and scale before filling.
prerequisites: Scale borrowed; order open
actions: Nella steadies the scale if it wobbles and lines the basket
consequences: A local preparation may be recorded; no stock changes until weighing
prose_obligations: Do not narrate a precise weight before the scale reading

scenes.role: Fill the neighbor’s order using the borrowed scale.
prerequisites: Order open; scale in Nella’s custody
actions: Add apples until the biased dial or available stock stops the fill
consequences: Apple stock and basket weight change; displayed reading is saved
prose_obligations: Distinguish a full-looking basket from a verified weight

scenes.role: Consolidated into filling or the reference-weight test when the scale wobbles.
prerequisites: Scale parameter says it wobbles
actions: Nella taps the dial to settle it before a reading
consequences: Only the enacted steadying action changes the settled flag
prose_obligations: Do not imply the scale is stable before the tap

scenes.role: Use a known 500-gram weight to test the scale.
prerequisites: Basket filled; scale borrowed
actions: Nella places the reference weight on the pan
consequences: Recorded reading reveals the exact positive bias
prose_obligations: Show the expected and actual readings

scenes.role: Consolidated with the reference-weight test; not a separate executable scene.
prerequisites: Reference weight has been read
actions: Nella recognizes the basket is short
consequences: Knowledge enables an honest correction or concealment choice
prose_obligations: Avoid an error magically known before the test

scenes.role: Make the dishonest alternative a playable consequential choice.
prerequisites: Nella knows the scale error
actions: Nella hands over the basket without disclosure
consequences: Neighbor leaves with the basket; later weighing exposes the shortage
prose_obligations: Let the choice be understandable without excusing it

scenes.role: Make the honest alternative a playable consequential choice.
prerequisites: Nella knows the scale error; neighbor is present
actions: Nella explains the short measure and apologizes
consequences: Neighbor can make an informed decision; trust rises
prose_obligations: Use ordinary direct dialogue rather than rule recitation

scenes.role: Consolidated into settlement after concealment; no effect runs if concealment was omitted.
scenes.location: Neighbor’s kitchen and the market stall
prerequisites: Nella concealed the error and neighbor took the basket
actions: Mrs. Vale checks the basket on her kitchen weight and returns
consequences: The shortage is exposed and trust falls
prose_obligations: Make the physical discovery and emotional cost visible

scenes.role: Correct the order when remaining apple stock is sufficient.
prerequisites: Error disclosed or exposed; enough apples remain
actions: Weigh the missing apples into the basket
consequences: Neighbor receives the requested weight of apples
prose_obligations: Do not call a pre-correction basket complete

scenes.role: Complete a short apple order with an agreed pear blend.
prerequisites: Apples are short; neighbor agrees to a blend; enough pears remain
actions: Weigh remaining apples and pears to the requested total
consequences: The order is fulfilled with a disclosed fruit change
prose_obligations: Make clear that the neighbor chooses the substitution

scenes.role: Resolve an order when there are too few apples and the neighbor declines pears.
prerequisites: Apple shortage; neighbor will not accept a pear blend
actions: Return the payment and restore fruit to the stall
consequences: The sale ends without a false measure
prose_obligations: Give the unsuccessful outcome an emotional close

scenes.role: Restore the borrowed object’s practical usefulness.
prerequisites: Order settlement is complete; scale remains borrowed
actions: Nella resets zero and retests the reference weight
consequences: Scale bias is corrected and verified
prose_obligations: Show a functional test, not just a custody handoff

scenes.role: Return the verified scale to Mr. Rafi.
prerequisites: Scale is reset and reference-tested
actions: Nella wipes the pan and hands it back
consequences: Owner and location agree; the object is usable for another customer
prose_obligations: The object must remain useful after the adventure

scenes.role: Close a correctly completed all-apple order.
prerequisites: Scale returned; order result is full
actions: Close the market episode with a checked order
consequences: Outcome distinguishes honesty from repair after concealment
prose_obligations: Earn the ending through enacted weighing and repair

scenes.role: Close a completed apples-and-pears order.
prerequisites: Scale returned; neighbor chose a complete blend
actions: Close the order at its requested total weight
consequences: A changed recipe is accepted or repaired after a breach
prose_obligations: Treat the neighbor’s choice as a real payoff

scenes.role: Close a canceled order without pretending the sale succeeded.
prerequisites: Scale returned; neighbor declined a pear blend
actions: End with returned payment and restored apples
consequences: The sale is lost, but the false measure is not passed on
prose_obligations: Let failure have an emotionally complete ending

scenes.role: Consolidated into the final image after the returned scale is used again.
prerequisites: Scale has been returned and verified
actions: Rafi weighs another customer’s oranges
consequences: The borrowed object’s usefulness is demonstrated
prose_obligations: Do not leave the scale merely owned but broken
